name: Milano-Sanremo
story: Milano-Sanremo began with nine riders forming the day’s breakaway. Before the Cipressa, a major crash disrupted the race, involving favorites Wout van Aert and Tadej Pogačar, forcing them to chase. Mathieu van der Poel also crashed earlier and had to recover. On the Cipressa, Pogačar attacked, with only Tom Pidcock and Van der Poel able to follow. On the Poggio, Pogačar dropped Van der Poel and rode to the finish with Pidcock, ultimately winning the sprint. Van Aert finished third after chasing back.
